evidence: Independent implementation of published probability rules and reference examples. No native Windows/DOS kernel execution or binary parity claim. Archive retrieval was unavailable because shell DNS resolution failed; general Multc99 source coverage remains unaudited.

sources.role: Multc Lean version, scope and fixed historical-rate addition in version 2.1.
Multc99 version and broader multiple-outcome command-line scope.
Thall-Simon-Estey marginal beta rules, N=30 numerical example, full versus reachable boundaries, joint outcome scenarios and look-ahead accrual.

Input ranges, margin conventions, pretrial rejection, cohorts, scenario order, exact operating characteristics and separate duration simulation. Original software redistribution is restricted; no original code or binaries are redistributed.

sources.author: John Venier
sources.role: Multc99 Phase IIa fixed-reference probability rule, complementary response cutoff, N=15 numerical tables and distinct display conventions. Final-cap placeholders are not posterior adverse-outcome thresholds.
Minimum/cohort enrollment rules and suspension of accrual only when pending outcomes could change the decision; duration behavior remains outside this implementation.

method_reference: Thall, Simon and Estey (1995), Bayesian sequential monitoring designs for single-arm clinical trials with multiple outcomes, Statistics in Medicine 14:357-379.
validation_reference: tools/reference_multc.R generates independent direct beta integrals, fixed-reference boundaries and full paired-outcome path enumeration. The script contains no native program source.
